title: CRIC Data Commons Architecture
summary: Registry, storage-tier, versioning and provenance architecture for CRIC raw, normalised, derived and training datasets.
notes: Dominant signals are implementation contracts: object hierarchy, YAML registry schema, required DatasetVersion fields, quality-metadata fields, format contracts (STAC/COG/GeoParquet) -> SPEC. Competing PRD signals: file sits under docs/CRIC-PRD-v0.1/ and ends with a 'v0.1 Acceptance Criteria' section; no user stories, no goals/non-goals. Ambiguity resolved to SPEC per SPEC > PRD precedence. No frontmatter, no status field. No markdown links or doc filenames referenced; 'cric-data' is named as a repository, not a doc path, so cross_refs left empty.
